name: bodyweight standing biceps curl
description: A standing bodyweight curl using secure fixed handles. Leaning back increases resistance as the biceps pull your body toward the handles.
instructions: Check that the handles and anchor are secure, then grip the handles with both hands and stand with feet planted.
Lean back slightly with your torso braced and arms extended in front of you.
Bend your elbows to pull your body toward the handles.
Extend your arms slowly to return, adjusting foot position to change difficulty.
